heading: **2 February 2026**
body:
*ELF\_dm\_EcoRV gel run repeat*

Molarity of octamer used per tube \= 48.6 nM

Molarity of protein (ELF2/ELF2m3 required) → 1 uM

For a 15 uL reaction ⇒ 150 ng nucleosome \+ 241 ng protein

Reactions to run on a gel:

1. ELFlig1 \+ EcoRV  
2. ELFlig1nuc \+ EcoRV  
3. ELFlig1nuc \+ ELF2/ELF2m3 \+ EcoRV (*this sample is prepared*)  
4. ELFlig1 \+ ELF2/ELF2m3 \+ EcoRV  
5. ELFlig1

We need to prepare the samples for ELFlig1 \+ ELF2/ELF2m3 \+ EcoRV.

ELFlig1 → 30.9 pmol in 15 uL solution

ELF2-2

| Component | Volume |
| ----- | ----- |
| **DNA (150 ng, 0 mM salt)** | **V\_DNA** |
| **ELF2-2 protein stock (150 mM salt)** | **1.04 µL** |
| **150 mM salt buffer (same as protein buffer, no protein)** | **7.96 µL** |
| **TE buffer / 0 mM buffer** | **(6.00 − V\_DNA) µL** |
| **Total** | **15.00 µL** |

ELF2m3

| Component | Volume |
| ----- | ----- |
| **DNA (150 ng, 0 mM salt)** | **V\_DNA** |
| **ELF2m3 protein stock (150 mM salt)** | **1.25 µL** |
| **150 mM salt buffer (same as protein buffer, no protein)** | **7.75 µL** |
| **TE buffer  / 0 mM buffer** | **(6.00 − V\_DNA) µL** |
| **Total** | **15.00 µL** |

Incubate at RT for 15 mins → 1.8 uL rCutsmart Buffer \+ 1 uL EcoRV

Add 0.4 uL Proteinase K & 0.94 uL 10% SDS (final conc \= 0.5% SDS). Incubate at 55 C, 10 mins.

Gel run order:

1. ELFlig1 \+ EcoRV  
2. ELFlig1nuc \+ EcoRV  
3. ELFlig1nuc \+ ELF2 \+ EcoRV   
4. ELFlig1nuc \+ ELF2m3 \+ EcoRV   
5. ELFlig1 \+ ELF2 \+ EcoRV  
6. ELFlig1 \+ ELF2m3 \+ EcoRV  
7. ELFlig1

Load 30 ng of each sample on the gel and run at 75 V for 2.5 hours in the cold room. Stain with SYBR Green after the gel run.

*Purify ELF ligands RF & FR and set up reconstitution*

All samples in the range of 300-400 ng/uL

*Prepare ligand plates for next SELEX*

*SELEX checklist*

GP5d media (500 mL)

| DMEM high glucose | Make up to 500 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| HI FBS (10%) | 50 mL |
| L-Glutamine | 5 mL |

293T Media

| HI FBS (10%) | 50 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| Sodium Pyruvate (100 mM) | 5 mL (1 mM final) |
| DMEM | Top up to 500 mL |

*Nucleosome reconstitution \- ELF ligands*

Resuspend in 20 uL of DNA

1. ELF2\_dm\_EcoRV (ELFlig1)  
2. ELF2\_RF  
3. ELF2\_FR

Take 4 ug of each DNA.

Molarity of DNA \= 1.68 uM

Molarity of octamer required \= 1.85 uM ⇒ 5.03 ug

Octamer concentration \= 5.4 ug/uL

Prepare 1.01 ug/uL stock (16 uL) ⇒ 3 uL of WT-octamer \+ 13 refolding buffer:glycerol 

Add 5 uL of this stock to each tube of the DNA \+ salt ⇒ Salt conc \= 1.83 M
title: ELF_dm_EcoRV gel run repeat
